name: Sahil Langoo

bio: Full Stack Systems Engineer and Co-Founder at @SquadCoders. Architecting ultra-fast static web architectures, distributed edge proxies, and local AI pipelines.

Demonstrated ability to boost website performance by 30-40% (sub-50ms TTFB, 0.00 CLS) and increase organic reach and user engagement by 20-30%. Dedicated to building software that is fast by default, zero-waste, and engineered with strict type safety.
